units.source_text: 我不曾——一句也不曾就一件事责备过母亲。

en.t: I had never reproached my mother for that matter, not even with a single word.

units.source_text: 估计母亲也没有察觉到我烧得那件事。

en.t: I suppose my mother had not noticed the matter of my having burned it, either.

units.source_text: 但是，从此以后，我心中就一直不原谅母亲。

en.t: But from then on, in my heart, I never forgave my mother.
